raw_definitions.categorical_arithmetic: Heavy/category IDs are not numeric material values. Paired tests use membership indicators, equality, sums and signed differences of indicators.
raw_definitions.coarseness: Use only these coarse fields; no exact piece-count vectors, king coordinates, or invented opponent advancement flag.
raw_definitions.heavy: 2*(0 if Q>0 else 1 if R>0 else 2) + int(N+B+opposite_coloured_bishop_pair_bonus > R+2*Q); unclipped Q/R/N/B counts.
raw_definitions.king_state: 4*int(our_relative_rank>=2) + 2*int(our_relative_rank>their_relative_rank) + int(king files are on opposite a-d/e-h halves).
raw_definitions.pawn_wings: Let us/them be 0 (pawnless), 1 (a-d pawns only), 2 (e-h pawns only), 3 (both wings). Code 0 if both==3; 1 if only us==3; 2 if only them==3; 3 if both nonzero single wings differ; otherwise 4.
raw_definitions.perspective: Us is side to move; each king relative rank is measured from that king own home rank, 0..7.
raw_definitions.pieces: min(15, occupied pieces of that side minus its king); includes pawns.
raw_definitions.relative_pawns: p=min(8,total,pawn count); 0 if p==0, else 1 if p<=total-p, else 2 if p<=total-p+2, else 3.
raw_definitions.signed_arithmetic: Promote operands before subtraction; no unsigned underflow.
